item.title: USG Passes resolutions addressing dining affordability, winter safety and creating Black history recognition

item.title: Snow and ice causes accessibility issues for disabled students
item.description: During the second weekend of the semester, Columbus saw a foot of snow which resulted in Ohio State moving classes online Jan. 26-27.
